photos.title: Ocean Forest Villas from above
photos.what: Ocean Forest Villas from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): five white condo buildings in two rows, lettered A to E from the lower left to the upper right, with parking lots behind them and two pools between them; N Ocean Blvd runs along the front; dunes and a strip of sand lie between the road and the Atlantic Ocean at the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Ocean Forest Villas from above: five buildings on the west side of N Ocean Blvd, with the dunes and the beach beyond the road.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the five Ocean Forest Villas condo buildings, lettered A to E, beside N Ocean Blvd in Myrtle Beach, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean at the lower right
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-15; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the batch 2026-11-d Palace record and the batch 2026-11-e Sea Mist record.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.

annotation_sources.Buildings A to E: center of each building's county unit parcels (zoning.json buildings, label.py)
annotation_sources.Atlantic Ocean: a point in the water inside the frame (label.py)

photos.original_size: 1600x1200 NAIP export, labels drawn, then resized
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/ocean-forest-villas/ on 2026-11-15. It shows: five condo buildings in two rows with the letters A to E placed from coordinates, parking lots, two pools, N Ocean Blvd along the front, dunes and sand beyond the road, and the Atlantic Ocean at the lower right. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
